messages:
maria gonzalez: Heads up — CI flagged an example in docs PR #412 that breaks with the v2 SDK when using streaming. The snippet still uses the old event-callback pattern. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

kevin_h: saw it. failing test points to docs/snippets/chat-streaming.ts:23. Quick fix is to switch to async iterator usage. I can open a patch branch today.

jordan: can we add a short note in the migration guide about backpressure/flush differences? folks hit timeouts if they blindly swap callbacks -> iterator.

lucas: agree. pinging product for wording. @maria g can you add a one-paragraph callout under "Streaming responses"?

maria gonzalez: sure. draft suggestion below — will add to the PR unless you want different phrasing:
```
Note: v2 streaming uses async iterators (for await...of). When upgrading from v1's `events` callback, convert like:
// v1 (old pattern)
client.on('token', cb)

// v2 (new pattern)
for await (const chunk of client.stream()) {
  // handle chunk
}
```
Will include a short example and a test.

docs-bot: PR 412 CI rerun queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/runs/3345 :spinner: 

kevin_h: also noticed another doc snippet referencing model `rwkv-small` — that model was removed from the public catalog last month. We should pick a stable replacement.

maria gonzalez: use `redwood/compact-1` — smallest verified and keeps examples consistent with the quickstart.

jordan: tiny nit — mark the code fence language as `ts` (typescript) so the snippet shows typings and syntax highlighting.

lucas: comms question — do we need to surface this in deprecation emails? It's small but could break sample apps. My suggestion: internal changelog + a docs banner, not full customer email.

maria gonzalez: OK. I'll add a changelog entry and a banner draft. planning to ship the banner on docs homepage tomorrow morning (UTC).

kevin_h: pushed branch `docs/412-stream-fix`, updated snippet, migration guide paragraph, and replaced model name. Requesting review from @jordan and @lucas.

jordan: reviewing now, left one wording suggestion on the migration paragraph.

lucas: lgtm for comms. @maria please include a short rollback plan and rollout window in the PR description.

maria gonzalez: done — PR description updated with rollout date 2026-03-25 and rollback steps (revert branch + docs banner removal).

docs-bot: PR 412 merged by kevin_h — deployment scheduled at 2026-03-25T09:00Z :white_check_mark: 

kevin_h: after deploy I'll run the example smoke tests and post results here. If anything flaps, we'll revert and notify customers via the internal incident channel.
